description: This file defines and implements the 'AvailabilityManager' React component, providing a user interface for managing doctor and ICU room availability windows. It includes functions for fetching data from backend API endpoints, rendering forms and tables, and handling CRUD operations for availability entries.

methods.name: api
methods.description: A minimal JSON fetch helper that performs HTTP requests to specified URLs, handling JSON responses and errors.

methods.name: fetchDoctors
methods.description: Fetches the list of doctors from the backend API.

methods.name: fetchICUs
methods.description: Fetches the list of ICU rooms from the backend API.

methods.name: fetchAvailabilities
methods.description: Fetches the list of availability entries from the backend API.

methods.name: createAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Creates a new availability entry on the backend via POST request.

methods.name: updateAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Updates an existing availability entry identified by ID via PUT request.

methods.name: deleteAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Deletes an availability entry by ID via DELETE request.
